finalized_content: The Glass Fabric Monitoring Layer provides total transparent omni-observability across all Camelot-OS nodes, unifying Cybertronia edge telemetry, Watchtower HUD, Tailscale mesh connectivity, and the Bifrost Bridge link. It synchronizes with the Canonical HTMX Dual Source interface on port 8096, serving zero-JS HTML fragments and client-side WebGPU tensor offload under the strict 4.0 GB RAM boundary while binding The Eleventh Law.
